description:
We are conducting a confidential search for a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated professional committed to delivering outstanding patient care and operational excellence.
The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring strict compliance with regulatory standards, and cultivating a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers a unique chance to significantly impact the quality of care and the overall success of the center.
Join a team that is deeply committed to providing top-tier rehabilitation services and fostering a thriving community for residents. We are seeking a visionary leader prepared to drive continuous improvement and uphold the highest standards of healthcare.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial performance, human resources, and quality assurance programs.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
